hypothesis: Removing only the fresh canonical breakout-onset requirement may recover repeatable ETH compression-pullback opportunities after realistic execution costs without degrading the frozen 60-bps stop behavior.
decision: Continue the isolated report-only observer and the frozen future-only diagnostic unchanged. The first resolved long path was positive after recorded visible-depth execution and official fees, but one long result and one pending long path do not support an ETH live route or a filter relaxation.
why_this_revision: The preregistered future-only window produced its first causally resolved non-overlapping exact-one-blocker execution path after the 2026-08-17T14:58:00Z cutoff.

future_one_blocker_experiment.candidate_definition: exactly two of three frozen entry conditions met with canonical_breakout_onset_absent as the sole blocker
future_one_blocker_experiment.entry: first complete visible-depth executable quote causally available after routing publication
future_one_blocker_experiment.overlap_policy: suppress additional same-side candidates until the primary horizon resolves
future_one_blocker_experiment.minimum_evidence: At least 20 independent candidates with both sides represented, complete exact-depth entry and exit paths, positive primary-horizon mean and median after nominal cost, positive stress mean after removing the largest winner, and no worse stop-path behavior than the frozen route.

pending_path.interpretation: The provisional mark is retained for traceability but cannot update economics before the frozen horizon or stop proxy resolves.

interpretation.comparison_with_no_action: Keeping v53 unchanged remains preferred because the ETH evidence is one-sided, N=1 resolved, and cannot survive a largest-winner-removal test by construction.

risks_and_failure_modes: One positive path can be ordinary variance and is the largest winner by definition.
All future-only candidates observed so far are long-side, leaving the configured short side untested.
The second selected path is pending and may materially change the tiny sample.
Recorded visible depth can cancel before a live IOC reaches the venue.
The stop proxy uses adverse BBO rather than an exact venue mark-trigger fill.
A fixed 15-minute diagnostic does not reproduce the route's full native maximum-hold lifecycle.

recommendation.Recommendation: Continue the frozen ETH observer and future-only one-blocker experiment without any live or parameter change.
recommendation.Why now: The first exact-depth path resolved positively, creating a real datapoint but not enough evidence for selection.
recommendation.Evidence reviewed: The immutable future-only observer prefix, exact visible-depth replay, official funding bundle, frozen identity and overlap policy, and prior revision.
recommendation.Observed problem or opportunity: The onset requirement excluded one long setup that earned 6.27 bps after recorded depth and fees over fifteen minutes.
recommendation.Applicable market regime: ETH transition structure with prior compression, a directional long pullback, and no fresh canonical five-minute breakout onset.
recommendation.Alternatives considered: Add ETH immediately, remove onset immediately, select the positive path, stop the observer, or continue the preregistered sample.
recommendation.Expected upside: Determines whether the observed positive path repeats across independent long and short episodes without risking v53 capital.
recommendation.Main risks and failure modes: N=1 variance, one-sided sampling, outlier dependence, pending-path reversal, recorded-book cancellation, and native-exit mismatch.
recommendation.Validation completed: Exact cutoff and identity, immutable ledger snapshot, official hourly funding coverage, causal entry and exit quotes, visible-depth capacity, fees, overlap suppression, and stop-path proxy.
recommendation.Validation still required: Nineteen additional independent resolved candidates at minimum, short-side evidence, stress and largest-winner sensitivity, exact stop behavior, and native lifecycle comparison.
recommendation.Success metrics: The unchanged twenty-candidate both-side contract with positive nominal mean and median, positive stress result after largest-winner removal, and no worse stop behavior.
recommendation.Failure / rollback triggers: Negative, one-sided, unresolved, or outlier-dependent evidence retains the current onset requirement; source or identity mismatch invalidates the window.
recommendation.Confidence level: high on the exact first-path arithmetic, low on repeatability and profitability

next_highest_value_investigation: Resolve the second non-overlapping ETH path while continuing exact v53 HYPE lifecycle collection; do not retune or select another horizon.
